text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server, protecting sensitive information from attackers. Strong authentication, such as complex passwords and two-factor verification, helps ensure that only authorized users can access accounts. Developers must also validate all user input to prevent common vulnerabilities like SQL injection and cross-site scripting. These attacks often happen when websites trust data without checking it. By focusing on HTTPS, secure authentication, and careful input validation, developers can reduce risks and build safer, more reliable web applications for everyone.
